text: 1. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens, hold valid foreign passports, friendly to China and without criminal records;2. Should be in good health condition based on the Foreign Students Physical Examination Standards by the Ministry of Education;3. Abide by the law in China and regulations of the university, and respect Chinese customs and habits;4. Graduate from senior high schools or above (equals to six-grade of middle school) and get good grades;5. Have good English or Chinese proficiency level;6. Generally should be over 18-year old and under 25-year-old;7. Should enter China with X1 Visa;
